name: Satellite Signal Receiver
description: Receive-only satellite ground-station app with an RTL-SDR local bridge, live spectrum, waterfall and FM audio for public weather and amateur satellite downlinks.

name: Satellite Red Team Lab
description: Simulated satellite red-team training lab with telemetry, a ground terminal, intentional sandbox vulnerabilities, SAFE MODE and avionics recovery.

name: Sky Survivors LIVE
description: Vertical TikTok LIVE dogfight survival: viewer pilots use the whole 9:16 screen, turn continuously, chase, overshoot and re-engage while likes repair, follows upgrade and gifts trigger combat boosts.

name: LIVE DROPZONE
description: Vertical TikTok LIVE top-down battle royale built from the shooter asset pack: viewers join as AI fighters, likes heal, follows upgrade weapons, roses level up, gifts trigger powers and a shrinking danger zone forces the final duel.

name: Pirate Ship Battle
description: Horizontal TikTok LIVE pirate battle: every viewer launches a colored ship with a visible username, auto-combat, progressive damage and sinking, while likes, follows, roses and gifts upgrade firepower, speed, shields and broadside abilities.

name: Frontline — Live War
description: TikTok LIVE frontline war: viewer soldiers auto-fight across seven sectors with three classes, reloads, grenades, sector capture, likes, follows and gift-driven reinforcements.

name: TikTok Fighter Arena
description: TikTok LIVE 1v1 fighter arena with viewer queue, winner-stays battles, gifts that evolve fighters, likes as potions, follows unlocking mid-tier fighters and rotating pixel arenas.

name: Live Arena
description: 2.5D isometric TikTok LIVE auto-battle arena: every viewer spawns a fighter, likes heal, gifts evolve stats, and combat runs automatically.

name: Live Rally Rush
description: Automated TikTok LIVE rally racer with viewer grid entry, single races, tournaments, gifts, nitro, VFX and customizable car colors.

name: TikTok World Earth
description: Mobile TikTok LIVE civilization simulator imported into one stable GitHub project path.

name: TikTok God World
description: English pixel kingdom simulator with living citizens, grounded buildings, contextual zoom UI, dynamic weather and instant big-gift help.

name: Kingdom War
description: Mobile LIVE kingdom war with fluid citizens, readable battles, alliances, gift-driven cities and an automatic cinematic camera.

name: Kingdom War 2
description: Kingdom war sequel with MiniFolks villagers, kingdom-coloured workers and soldiers, and roaming forest animals.

name: Kingdom War 3
description: Survivor siege arena: two smaller fortified kingdoms, champion shield, ports, true wall construction, large NPC armies, rebuilding and gift-driven reinforcements.

name: World Kingdoms LIVE
description: Autonomous living-world civilization simulator for TikTok LIVE with six viewer-supported kingdoms, a fresh procedural map, physical settlements and armies, council votes and a remote TikFinity bridge.

name: Neon Orbit
description: Touch-first arcade sample used to prove the same-URL edit → commit → deploy loop.

name: Game Hub Workspace
description: The mobile AI development workspace itself.
